text:
The plate is a square-ish plate about 350 px wide, which I'd take as roughly 22-24 cm across, so about 15 px per cm.

The food is glazed carrot pieces, about 10 of them, with the cluster roughly 250 px wide (about 14 cm) and 170 px tall. The pieces are halves or chunks, with the largest about 6 cm long.

A medium carrot is about 60 g, and these look like thick halves of about 25-30 g each. Ten pieces gives roughly 200-250 g, so I'll say 200 g.

Cooked carrots run about 40 kcal per 100 g. Glazed ones with butter or sugar come to about 70 kcal per 100 g, so 200 g is about 140 kcal.

{"kcal": 140, "mass_g": 200}
